description: Recreation of the interactive 'Global Temperature Record' line chart from temperaturerecord.org (powered by the 2 Degrees Institute / climatelevels.org). Shows global surface temperature anomaly (base period 1951-1980) from the year 1000 to present, combining paleoclimatic reconstructions (annual resolution, to 1879) with modern NASA GISS instrumental records (monthly resolution, 1880-present). Scroll to zoom and drag to pan. Written directly in Vega (not Vega-Lite) so tracked signals (hover, pan_zoom) are backed by real signal values rather than Vega-Lite's internal `_store` datasets, which reVISit's replay mechanism cannot repopulate. revisitAnswer rides on the existing hover interaction (responseId "line-extremum-hover", with no matching "response" entry in config.json).

on.update: tooltip && tooltip.ts === datum.ts ? tooltip : {'ts': datum.ts, 'Date': timeFormat(datum.ts, '%B %d, %Y'), 'Anomaly (\u00b0C)': format(datum.value, '.2f')}
